The refund deadline for the gravy boat has passed. Your earlier proposal was made in time and became invalid before it was paid, so a staff member will take the case and a person will take over from here (refund-policy/v2/window). I can't promise an outcome.

The ceramic soup tureen was already refunded, with receipt number **R-H461-0001** for BRL 46.33. It is recorded against your order's original payment. A unit can't be refunded a second time (refund-policy/v2/remaining).
